description:
Hi everyone!

It's almost Xmas now and Cadbury Chocolate is a staple in the UK as far gifting is concerned. 
Do you have a favorite Cadbury treat?

Ice Cream is a treat that you can have all year, on the beach in the summer or in front of the fire in winter, there's always room for Ice Cream. This Ultimate Cadbury Ice Cream is so incredibly yummy, i'm sure you'll want to try this one yourself. 

The ingredients you'll need are:

500ml Milk
600ml Double (Heavy) cream
6 egg yolks
300g Sugar
120g Cadbury Dairy Milk Chocolate
2 Tsp of Cadbury Cocoa Powder
1 Cadbury Flake
1/2 Pack of Cadbury Fingers
1-2 tbsp Mozart Chcolate Liqueur (Optional)

Interestingly, Cadbury used to make a Chocolate Liqueur but stopped selling it years ago. 

If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)
We also have a Facebook group were we talk and post images of Ice Creams and our social media pages are all about sweet treats so head on over.

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)
tags: how to make ice cream at home

chapters.title: add six egg yolks into a separate bowl
add around five tablespoons of the milk
add 120 grams of cadburys dairy milk
pour it into a large jug
pour in 600 ml of the double cream
pour this silky mixture into your ice cream maker
throw in about half of your chocolate chunks into your ice cream
add the rest of your chocolate chunks
finish off with a generous squirt of dark chocolate sauce
